q: What CBAM figure applies to bars re-rolled in Bhavnagar from Alang ship plates?
title: Bhavnagar ship plate re-rolling CBAM
short: Mostly just your reheating furnace fuel. Plates cut from ships are usually treated like scrap, with zero embedded emissions, and electricity is not counted for steel. Keep the purchase records that show the plates came from ship breaking.
audience: Re-rolling mills in Bhavnagar and Sihor using plates from Alang ship recycling

ul: Furnace oil, coal or gas burned in the reheating furnace.
Any billets or ingots bought in, which carry their own embedded emissions.
Not the ship plates, if they are accepted as scrap.

p: Plates re-rolled without melting are an unusual route. Agree with the importer and its verifier that they are treated as scrap before the figure is sent.

ul: Purchase bills naming the ship breaking plot.
Fuel bills for the furnace by month.

senseible: Senseible reads fuel, electricity and production documents into dated, fingerprinted installation records, the starting point for the actual emissions an EU importer asks for.
